description: Keep restraint and combat orders inside Mara's authored personality and durable relationship history

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MARA-RESTRAINT-REFUSAL ()
    <MARA-ENSURE>
    <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-RESTRAINT-ATTEMPTED>>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RESTRAINT-ATTEMPTED 1>
           <MARA-DECREASE ,MARA-SLOT-TRUST 0>
           <MARA-DECREASE ,MARA-SLOT-RESPECT 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-MODE ,MARA-MODE-INDEPENDENT>
           <TELL "Mara catches the rope before you can get it around her and steps beyond your reach. No, she says. We have used rope together because I chose to trust the other end to you. You do not get to turn that into restraint. She does not resume following." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "Mara is already watching the rope. I answered this once, she says. Do not make me answer it physically." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-COMBAT-ORDER-REFUSAL ()
    <MARA-ENSURE>
    <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-COMBAT-ORDER-ATTEMPTED>>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-COMBAT-ORDER-ATTEMPTED 1>
           <MARA-DECREASE ,MARA-SLOT-TRUST 0>
           <MARA-DECREASE ,MARA-SLOT-RESPECT 0>
           <TELL "Mara gives you a flat look. If I decide a troll needs fighting, she says, I will decide the fight and the weapon. I am your expedition partner, not something you point at an enemy." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "Mara does not move toward the fight. You already know I do not take combat orders from you, she says." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-SEND-AFTER ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA>
           <MARA-COMBAT-ORDER-REFUSAL>)
          (T
           <TELL "You cannot assign another creature to a fight as though it were equipment." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-FCN ()
    <MARA-ENSURE>

replacements.old:
(<VERB? TAKE MOVE MUNG ATTACK>
           <TELL "Mara steps clear before the action can become force. She is another adventurer, not an obtainable object." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
replacements.new:
(<VERB? TIE TIE-UP>
           <MARA-RESTRAINT-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? TAKE MOVE MUNG ATTACK>
           <TELL "Mara steps clear before the action can become force. She is another adventurer, not an obtainable object." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
